summary: C0-04DA-2 analogue output module arrangement: mounting, interface and service-space coordination.
description: C0-04DA-2 is the drawing identifier for analogue output module in AutomationDirect's CLICK PLCs collection. An analogue output module sends a variable control signal to connected equipment. The equipment schedule and wiring design establish the actual output type and load.

For example, in a plant panel sending adjustable commands to a valve or drive, use the C0-04DA-2 reference to coordinate output-terminal approach, module removal and the controller connection. Show the neighbouring equipment and the connection route so the installer can understand the intended arrangement.

Use the reviewed native drawing identified as PLC Families/CLICK/C0-04DA-2.dwg for the exact physical details. Locate the named file in its original manufacturer archive. Manufacturer drawing previews are shown only when an exact approved source is available. Any illustrative 3D view is a separate concept and is not to scale; use the selected manufacturer documents for dimensions, ratings and installation details.
